alignment.method: Unprompted local whisper.cpp base.en candidate recognition; small.en-q5_1 separate boundary and final-clip recognition; agent comparison with the official NASA transcript and all five unchanged tasks.
checks: e1: complete management/status-quo versus leadership/change explanation retained.
e2: guest's explicit caveat that management is not bad retained.
e3: Astros analogy, changing resources and tomorrow's mission retained.
e4: continuous original recording allows a real 5–10 second replay and comparison.
e5: original fictional transfer task unchanged; no NASA endorsement of its suggested action.
notes: Both local decoders recognize the complete opening question and final tomorrow clause.
Both ASR decoders misrecognize Dare. Unite. Explore.; the displayed text preserves NASA's official spelling.
limitations: ASR and textual/source alignment are not human listening or an expert acoustic review.
ASR timestamps are estimates and can extend beyond a segment. Published clip bounds are exact source frame cuts selected in low-energy pauses, not publisher-supplied timestamps.
The displayed official transcript normalizes some spontaneous repetitions and wording; ASR mistakes are not silently substituted into it.
